name: Ember Kitchen
description: A website for a fictional wood-fired café with online pickup ordering: a menu with categories, a bag, pickup times worked out from opening hours, and a kitchen board that moves orders from new to ready.
features: Menu with category tabs and add-to-bag
Pickup times worked out from opening hours and the café's time zone
Order form checked in the browser and on the server
Kitchen board that moves orders from new to preparing to ready
Scroll entrances and an "oven door" opening, off for users who turn off animations
Responsive, keyboard-accessible design

name: Kestrel Hill Observatory
description: A responsive landing page for a fictional public observatory, with a Moon phase calculator, a ticket builder that totals as you go, and scroll animations.
features: Moon phase calculator for the next six Fridays
Hover-to-preview list of the season’s sky
Ticket builder with a live total
Evening timeline and FAQ accordion
Parallax and scroll animations, off for users who turn off animations
Responsive, keyboard-accessible design

name: Corn Pest Detector
description:
This is a thesis project focused on developing an AI-powered Corn Pest and Disease Detection Application using machine learning and computer vision.

The goal is to help farmers identify possible corn pests and diseases by taking a picture of an affected corn plant. The AI model analyzes the image, identifies the possible pest or disease, and provides information to help users understand the problem.

The application will use Flutter for the mobile app UI and TensorFlow for AI model development and image classification.
features: Capture images using the phone camera.
Upload images from the gallery.
Detect corn pests and diseases using TensorFlow.
Identify the detected pest or disease.
Display AI prediction confidence percentage.
Show descriptions, symptoms, and affected plant areas.
Provide recommended treatments and prevention methods.
Save previous detection results.

name: BizPulse Dashboard
description: An admin analytics dashboard for a fictional courts and café business, with period-over-period KPIs, revenue and busy-hours charts, and a searchable orders table on 90 days of demo data.
features: KPI strip compared with the previous period
Revenue, weekday and busy-hours heatmap charts
Orders table with search, type filter and sorting
Date range and filters saved in the URL
CSV export of the filtered orders
Light and dark mode, responsive down to phones
